args.title: Agentic threat landscape, Q3 2025
args.body:
## Summary
Agentic systems introduce execution-layer risks that model-boundary guardrails miss. This report surveys 40 papers across five threat classes: goal manipulation, tool misuse, memory poisoning, inter-agent trust, and behavioural drift. We find detection is strongest on command-shaped code execution and weakest on plainly-worded misuse and multi-step memory attacks. ## Recommendations
1. Instrument the tool-call and A2A boundaries with content detection. 2. Treat retrieved and stored text as untrusted. 3. Measure on held-out, outsider-written corpora, not in-sample probes.
